summary.text: Jeremy McPike is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 29.
The Senate biography lists Jeremy McPike's service in the Senate since 2016.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, Jeremy McPike was born in Washington, D.C., on September 19, 1975.
Jeremy McPike studied at George Mason University (B.A., Government, and M.P.A.).
Jeremy McPike's listed occupation is director of general services for the City of Alexandria.
Jeremy McPike's listed memberships and affiliations include Sacred Heart Catholic Church.
The biography lists Sharon L. McPike as Jeremy McPike's spouse.
The Senate page lists Jeremy McPike's committee assignments as General Laws and Technology (Chair), Commerce and Labor, Finance and Appropriations, Local Government, and Rules.
